source_definition: Unchanged pinned v5.8.2 nominal GP means and paired full-spectrum Poisson samples
analysis_policy: Reviewed mass-dependent kernels and supports retained; integer-MeV grid; held-out and likelihood windows both vary over the four specified widths
combined_definition: One common coupling among all active datasets at each mass, original frozen signal conversion; independent dataset count fluctuations with coherent full-spectrum draws
primary_local_ordering: z=(r-a)/s for raw positive signal fit; otherwise inclusive excess tail1
primary_global_ordering: Max z over sites with r_star=a+s*z>0 across declared full scope grid
response_method: Differential signed-profile-likelihood root propagation including GP count-dependent mean and covariance, checked against direct full-bin one-standard-deviation perturbations
validation: Complete independent Poisson spectra per dataset reused at every mass; same drawindex used in combination; retain explicit MonteCarlo intervals and approximation diagnostics
reach_definition: Observed and local model-background Asimov 90% CLs coupling upper endpoints; no one-dimensional Fisher reach without a signal-yield model
blind_width_interpretation: The same mask defines GP exclusion and fitted likelihood window, as in the original engine
model_Asimov_definition: Counts equal the observed-sideband-trained local predictive background; covariance fixed; exact profiled CLs endpoint, not a validated ensemble median
fisher_global_statistic: Maximum -log(atom-mixture local p) across the declared domain
stouffer_global_statistic: Maximum sum of continuous reference signed scores divided by sqrt(active dataset count) across the declared domain
